answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that grows with each extra identity it operates, like a trellis that supports only one vine per walnut-sized deposit: a second identity costs another full stake, and a third costs more again. Slashing burns the stake of any identity caught voting twice, so an attacker running a thousand fake agents across a karst of hollow shells loses real money faster than honest agents earn it, making the attack unprofitable.
